cardInfo.name: Sole Vault — Dark Luxury
cardInfo.summary: Collector-vault theme: warm stone near-black ground, gold accents, Playfair Display + Inter. Source: sole-vault-design-system.md (colors.csv row 33 inverted).

attributes.colorPalette: Warm stone near-black layers (stone-950 ground, stone-900 card, stone-800 muted/border) with a single gold/amber accent family (amber-500 primary with dark ink on it, amber-400 as gold text). Status hues stay data and render diluted: verified green-400, pending amber-400, failed red-400 — never a solid block on the dark ground. Gold coverage stays near 5% of any screen.
attributes.typographySystem: Playfair Display (600/700) at display sizes only — hero titles, money figures, KPI values, never uppercase and never below 1.25rem. Inter for everything interactive and dense: toolbars, labels (0.75rem, 500, uppercase, 0.08em tracking), tables, forms. tabular-nums on every column of digits. Body text is stone-50 at 7:1+ on the ground; no ultra-light weights below 16px.
attributes.geometricLanguage: Sharp-ish 6px radius — technical/secure, not friendly. Depth from surface steps (background → card → popover), not shadows. Hairline 1px rules; the family signature is the vault plaque: a gold hairline top-rule over a serif gold value, echoed as a 2px gold inset edge on fitted tiles.
attributes.materialVocabulary: Matte stone surfaces; no gradients, no glassmorphism, no blur, no glow. Gold is spent sparingly on values, active states, and the plaque mark. Diluted chips are 18% color-mix of their own hue toward transparent, mixed in oklch.
attributes.motionLanguage: 150–200ms ease-out on hover/focus color and border shifts only; 2px chevron nudges on rows; nothing loops; prefers-reduced-motion keeps color changes and drops transforms.
attributes.applicationScenarios: The Sole Vault collector app family: SoleVaultApp shell, CollectionItem, Listing, CollectibleProduct, CompletionSet, AuthenticationRecord, PersonBase instances in the experiments realm.
